name: Memories-of-Mars
description: This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install Memories of Mars and run it. ATTENTION: First Startup can take very long since it downloads the gameserver files! ONLINE PLAY: Please be sure to set the variable MULTIHOME to the IP of your Unraid server otherwise you can't connect to the gameserver! Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available. You can also run multiple servers with only one SteamCMD directory!

variables.name: GAME_ID
variables.description: The GAME_ID that the container download at startup. (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List)

variables.name: Extra Game Parameters
variables.description: Enter Extra Startup Parameters here if needed, otherwise leave empty (eg: '-port=7778', '-maxplayers=12')

variables.name: Multihome Target
variables.description: This has to be the IP of your Unraid server otherwise you can't connect to the game and the game will lost connection to the server!

variables.name: Steam-Username
variables.description: Your Steam username goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).

variables.name: Validate Installation
variables.description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.

variables.name: Steam-Password
variables.description: Your Steam password goes here if you want to install a game that needs a valid account, otherwise leave it blank (ATTENTION: You have to disable Steam Guard).
